title: Manipur: CM pushes for revival of indigenous sports

ai.summary: Manipur Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh called for efforts to preserve and promote indigenous sports and cultural practices during a demonstration of Naga Indigenous Wrestling at the Astro Turf Ground in Senapati.

facts.claim: Manipur Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh called for concerted efforts to preserve and promote the indigenous sports, traditional arts and cultural practices of the state’s diverse communities
facts.quote: Senapati: Manipur Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh on Monday called for concerted efforts to preserve and promote the indigenous sports, traditional arts and cultural practices of the state’s diverse communities.

facts.claim: He made the appeal while attending a demonstration of Naga Indigenous Wrestling (Pyacha) at the Astro Turf Ground in Senapati, organised by the Senapati District Wrestling Association Manipur (SDWAM)
facts.quote: He made the appeal while attending a demonstration of Naga Indigenous Wrestling (Pyacha) at the Astro Turf Ground in Senapati, organised by the Senapati District Wrestling Association Manipur (SDWAM).

facts.claim: Drawing parallels between Pyacha and the Meitei traditional wrestling form of Mukna, Khemchand said every community has distinctive sporting traditions that deserve recognition and encouragement
facts.quote: Drawing parallels between Pyacha and the Meitei traditional wrestling form of Mukna, Khemchand said every community has distinctive sporting traditions that deserve recognition and encouragement.

facts.claim: Recalling his own association with martial arts, the Chief Minister said he had practised the traditional Meitei martial art of Thang-Ta during childhood
facts.quote: Recalling his own association with martial arts, the Chief Minister said he had practised the traditional Meitei martial art of Thang-Ta during childhood.

facts.claim: He later took up Taekwondo after being inspired by Bruce Lee’s film Enter the Dragonwhile studying in Class IX in the 1970s
facts.quote: He later took up Taekwondo after being inspired by Bruce Lee’s film Enter the Dragonwhile studying in Class IX in the 1970s.

facts.claim: Khemchand, who was recently conferred the title of Grand Master 9th DAN in Traditional Taekwondo by the Global Traditional Taekwondo Federation, said he had come to Senapati to encourage the promotion of Naga Indigenous Wrestling
facts.quote: Khemchand, who was recently conferred the title of Grand Master 9th DAN in Traditional Taekwondo by the Global Traditional Taekwondo Federation, said he had come to Senapati to encourage the promotion of Naga Indigenous Wrestling.

facts.claim: Highlighting the participation of 25 communities in the wrestling event, the Chief Minister said their coming together sent a strong message of unity and peace
facts.quote: Highlighting the participation of 25 communities in the wrestling event, the Chief Minister said their coming together sent a strong message of unity and peace.

facts.claim: He noted that all 36 communities of Manipur collectively contribute to the state
facts.quote: He noted that all 36 communities of Manipur collectively contribute to the state.

facts.claim: He also stressed the responsibility of the present generation of elders to work towards restoring and sustaining peace for the benefit of future generations
facts.quote: He also stressed the responsibility of the present generation of elders to work towards restoring and sustaining peace for the benefit of future generations.

ai.background_note: The Chief Minister's visit coincided with Janjatiya Gaurav Divas, a festival honoring tribal freedom fighter Birsa Munda, and included distributing sports gear to encourage young talent.
